tiles.title: Provider Attempt Outcomes
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("trace.metadata.openrouter.provider_name", 'unknown') AS provider,
  CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 OR "span.level" = 'ERROR' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'succeeded' END AS outcome,

tiles.title: Reliability by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH retries AS (
  SELECT span_trace_id, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts
  FROM $traces_dataset
  WHERE "span.type" = 'span' AND (span_status_code = 2 OR "span.level" = 'ERROR')
  GROUP BY span_trace_id
)
SELECT g."gen_ai.request.model" AS model,
  COUNT(*) AS requests,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.span_status_code = 2 OR g."span.level" = 'ERROR') AS final_errors,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.span_status_code <> 2 AND COALESCE(g."span.level", 'DEFAULT') <> 'ERROR') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(r.failed_attempts, 0) > 0) AS requests_retried
FROM $traces_dataset g
LEFT JOIN retries r ON g.span_trace_id = r.span_trace_id
WHERE g."span.type" = 'generation'
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR g."gen_ai.request.model" = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR g."trace.metadata.openrouter.provider_name" = '$provider')
  AND ('$api_key' = 'All' OR g."trace.metadata.openrouter.api_key_name" = '$api_key')
  AND ('$finish_reason' = 'All' OR g."trace.metadata.openrouter.finish_reason" = '$finish_reason')
GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Retry Trace Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT g.p_timestamp, g.span_trace_id,
  g."gen_ai.request.model" AS model,
  g."trace.metadata.openrouter.provider_name" AS final_provider,
  COUNT(a.span_span_id) AS provider_attempts,
  COUNT(a.span_span_id) FILTER (WHERE a.span_status_code = 2 OR a."span.level" = 'ERROR') AS failed_attempts,
  ROUND(g.span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS request_duration_s,
  ROUND(g."gen_ai.usage.total_cost", 8) AS cost_usd
FROM $traces_dataset g
JOIN $traces_dataset a ON g.span_trace_id = a.span_trace_id AND a."span.type" = 'span'
WHERE g."span.type" = 'generation'
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR g."gen_ai.request.model" = '$model')
